{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Null Runner''' was the first enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had lower health than the [[Nulling]] but it was far faster than it. ==Logbook Description== "''Null Runners are quick enemies that can scale most surfaces with their strong grip and claws. They hunt methodically, stalking their prey and wearing them down to exhaustion. These creatures often tease the weaker [[Nulling]]s, at least until a [[Null Dredge]] shows up.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Runner''' is a thin, purple enemy. Tendrils sprout from its body, with a slightly more saturated color. It has an exposed set of teeth, which are slightly yellowed. Its joints are slightly more saturated - with them being its elbows, knees and midsection. It has a dome-like head, with no eyes and small horns. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *The '''Null Runner''' is quite weak, meaning most early-game towers can handle it. **Single target towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] can be used. **AOE towers like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Military Base]] or [[Mortar]] can clear these out quite well, as it generally spawns in hordes. *Later on, the '''Null Runner''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Minigunner]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullRunner1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullRunner2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) CorpseNullRunner3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NULLNVOIDNIGHT1THUMB.png|'''Null Runner''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} Null&VoidNight1Hour12.png|'''Null Runner''' on the game icon.
